notes.title: Explore the Corner of a Dream in NIDANA, to be Released in 2025
notes.notes:
She continues to dream—this is a first-person dream walking simulator where you explore the corner of a dream.

There is no text whatsoever, only surreal geometrical spaces for you to explore. 

[previewyoutube=KYrQm2P2f34;full][/previewyoutube]
Please look forward to the release in 2025 and add the game to your wishlist.
